extra_vocab.en: a list that shows who came to work or a class and when
extra_vocab.note: 文章要求員工回覆確認出席，這類出席資料最後會被整理成出席紀錄。常用於公司人資、課程與會議的管理。
extra_vocab.pattern: keep / check / update + the attendance record

examples.en: Ms. Lin checks the attendance record at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 林小姐每個月底都會檢查出勤紀錄。

examples.en: Please keep an accurate attendance record for every training session.
examples.zh: 請為每一場訓練課程保留正確的出席紀錄。

examples.en: Her attendance record shows she missed only one meeting this year.
examples.zh: 她的出席紀錄顯示今年只缺席過一場會議。

similar.diff: attendance sheet 是當場簽名的表單；attendance record 是整理後的完整紀錄。

example.en: Please sign the attendance sheet before you enter the meeting room.
example.zh: 進入會議室前請先在出席表上簽名。

confusable.diff: attendance rate 指出席的比率；attendance record 指出席的紀錄內容。

example.en: The attendance rate for the workshop was above ninety percent.
example.zh: 工作坊的出席率超過百分之九十。

extra_vocab.en: present at an event or meeting
extra_vocab.note: 文章是要求大家確認出席，in attendance 常用在正式報導或通知，說明誰有到場，語氣比 present 更正式。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + be in attendance / those in attendance
extra_vocab.grammar_note: in attendance 前面不加 the，也不說 in the attendance；放在 be 動詞後，或放在名詞後面修飾。

examples.en: All department heads were in attendance at the quarterly meeting.
examples.zh: 所有部門主管都出席了季會。

examples.en: Over two hundred guests were in attendance at the opening dinner.
examples.zh: 兩百多位賓客出席了開幕晚宴。

examples.en: The names of those in attendance will be listed in the minutes.
examples.zh: 出席者的姓名會列在會議紀錄中。

similar.diff: present 較口語，常放 be 後；in attendance 較正式。

example.en: Only five members were present when the meeting started.
example.zh: 會議開始時只有五位成員在場。

similar.diff: attend 是及物動詞，後面直接接活動，不加介系詞。

example.en: Please attend the safety training on Thursday afternoon.
example.zh: 請在星期四下午參加安全訓練。

confusable.diff: absent 是「缺席的」，和 in attendance 意思相反。

example.en: Two staff members were absent because of the heavy rain.
example.zh: 兩位員工因為大雨而缺席。

extra_vocab.en: to check who is present at a meeting or class
extra_vocab.note: 文章要求大家事先確認出席，主辦方會藉此掌握人數；現場則常用 take attendance 來點名，多用於課程、訓練與會議。
extra_vocab.pattern: take attendance + at / before + 時間或場合
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attendance 是不可數名詞，不加 a 也不加 s，所以說 take attendance，不說 take an attendance。

examples.en: The trainer will take attendance at the start of each class.
examples.zh: 講師會在每堂課開始時點名。

examples.en: Please take attendance before the manager begins the presentation.
examples.zh: 請在經理開始簡報前記錄出席名單。

examples.en: We take attendance every morning to check who is working today.
examples.zh: 我們每天早上點名，確認今天誰上班。

similar.diff: check attendance 也能用，語氣更一般，強調確認人數。

example.en: The assistant will check attendance when the guests arrive.
example.zh: 賓客抵達時，助理會確認出席人數。

similar.diff: call the roll 是逐一唱名，較傳統，多用於學校。

example.en: The teacher began to call the roll at nine o’clock.
example.zh: 老師九點開始點名。

confusable.diff: take part in 是「參加」某活動；take attendance 是「點名」。

example.en: All employees are welcome to take part in the safety workshop.
example.zh: 歡迎所有員工參加安全工作坊。

extra_vocab.en: the fact of being in a place at a certain time
extra_vocab.note: 在出席相關的語境中，presence 指人「有到場」；比 attendance 更強調「人在現場」這件事，也常用在邀請函中的 your presence。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: presence 通常不可數；常說 in the presence of + 人，表示「在…面前」。

example.en: The contract was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
example.zh: 合約是在兩位見證人面前簽署的。

example.en: Your presence at the meeting on Monday is required.
example.zh: 您必須出席星期一的會議。

example.en: Her presence at the meeting helped the team make a decision.
example.zh: 她出席會議幫助團隊做出決定。

examples.en: We would be pleased to have your presence at our annual dinner.
examples.zh: 我們很榮幸邀請您出席年度晚宴。

examples.en: The presence of a guard at the gate makes visitors feel safe.
examples.zh: 大門有警衛在場，讓訪客覺得安心。

examples.en: The company has a strong presence in the Asian market.
examples.zh: 這家公司在亞洲市場很有影響力。

confusable.diff: present 是形容詞（在場的）或名詞（禮物），presence 是「在場」這件事。
confusable.usage: present 當動詞「簡報、呈現」時重音在後 /prɪˈzɛnt/；presence 只當名詞。

example.en: Every member must be present when the manager makes the announcement.
example.zh: 經理發布公告時，每位成員都必須在場。

confusable.diff: absence 是「缺席」，和 presence 意思相反。

example.en: His absence from the meeting was noticed by the whole team.
example.zh: 他沒出席會議，整個團隊都注意到了。

similar.diff: attendance 指出席的行為或人數；presence 強調人在現場。

example.en: Attendance at the training session is required for all new staff.
example.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加訓練課程。

example.en: Attendance at the weekly meeting has increased this month.
example.zh: 本月每週會議的出席人數增加了。

example.en: The manager made a brief appearance at the staff party.
example.zh: 經理在員工派對上短暫露了面。

derived.link: presence 的名詞字尾 -ence，來自 present + -ence，像 independent → independence

example.en: All present members voted to approve the new budget.
example.zh: 所有在場成員都投票通過新預算。

example.en: The team is presently working on the new sales plan.
example.zh: 團隊目前正在處理新的業務計畫。

example.en: Her presentation on the new product impressed the board.
example.zh: 她的新產品簡報讓董事會留下深刻印象。

senses.en: being at a place or event

example.en: Your presence at the opening ceremony would mean a lot to us.
example.zh: 您出席開幕典禮對我們意義重大。

senses.en: the position a company has in a market or place
senses.distinguish: 常搭配 strong、market、in Asia 等，指企業的存在感。

example.en: The firm plans to build a stronger presence in Europe.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫在歐洲建立更強的據點。

extra_vocab.en: the fact of not being at a place where you should be
extra_vocab.note: 文章提到無法出席的員工要事先提交進度，也就是為了處理「缺席」造成的資訊落差。absence 常用在公司請假與會議紀錄中。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: absence from + 地點／工作（缺席）；absence of + 事物（缺少某物），兩個介系詞意思不同。

example.en: Too many absences may affect the employee’s yearly performance review.
example.zh: 太多次缺席可能影響員工的年度考核。

example.en: Please report any absence from work to your supervisor early.
example.zh: 任何缺勤請儘早向主管報告。

example.en: In the absence of the manager, Ms. Wu will lead the meeting.
example.zh: 經理不在時，吳小姐會主持會議。

example.en: He asked for a leave of absence to finish his studies.
example.zh: 他申請留職停薪以完成學業。

examples.en: Frequent absence from the training sessions may lead to a warning.
examples.zh: 常缺席訓練課程可能會收到警告。

examples.en: The director’s absence caused the meeting to be moved to Friday.
examples.zh: 主任缺席，導致會議改到星期五。

examples.en: The report noted an absence of clear safety rules in the office.
examples.zh: 報告指出辦公室缺乏明確的安全規定。

confusable.diff: presence 是「在場」，和 absence 意思相反。

example.en: The manager’s presence at the event made the guests feel welcome.
example.zh: 經理出席活動，讓賓客覺得受到歡迎。

confusable.diff: absent 是形容詞（缺席的），absence 是名詞（缺席這件事）。
confusable.usage: be absent from + 地點或活動；名詞 absence 後面也可接 from。

example.en: Mr. Hall was absent from work because of a high fever.
example.zh: 霍爾先生因為高燒沒來上班。

similar.diff: time off 指請假休息，語氣較口語；absence 重點在「人不在」。

example.en: She asked for time off to attend her sister’s wedding.
example.zh: 她請假去參加姊姊的婚禮。

example.en: Employees may take sick leave with a doctor’s note.
example.zh: 員工憑醫師證明可以請病假。

example.en: Mr. Lee is on vacation until the end of the month.
example.zh: 李先生休假到月底。

derived.link: absence 的 -ence 改成 -ent，變成形容詞，像 present

example.en: Three team members were absent from the morning briefing.
example.zh: 有三位組員缺席早上的說明會。

derived.link: absent + -ee，被點到缺席的人，像 employee

example.en: The manager sent a summary to every absentee after the meeting.
example.zh: 會後經理寄了摘要給每位缺席者。

senses.en: not being at a place or event

example.en: Her absence from the conference was announced this morning.
example.zh: 她缺席研討會一事在今早宣布。

senses.distinguish: 後面接 of + 事物，不是人。

example.en: The absence of clear instructions confused the new employees.
example.zh: 缺少明確的指示讓新進員工很困惑。

extra_vocab.en: a person who takes part in an event or activity
extra_vocab.note: 指參與會議、課程或活動的人，比 attendee 稍強調「有參與」。常見於報名資料、活動通知與調查報告。

example.en: All participants will receive a free lunch at the workshop.
example.zh: 所有參加者都能在工作坊中領到免費午餐。

example.en: Workshop participants should bring a laptop and a notebook.
example.zh: 工作坊參加者請攜帶筆電與筆記本。

example.en: Please check your name on the participant list at the desk.
example.zh: 請在櫃台的參加者名單上確認你的名字。

example.en: Ms. Jones is an active participant in every team discussion.
example.zh: 瓊斯小姐積極參與每一次團隊討論。

examples.en: Each participant must sign in at the front desk before the event.
examples.zh: 每位參加者必須在活動前於櫃台簽到。

examples.en: Participants in the survey will receive a ten dollar gift card.
examples.zh: 參與調查的人將獲得一張十美元禮卡。

examples.en: The trainer asked each participant to introduce a new idea.
examples.zh: 講師請每位參加者介紹一個新想法。

confusable.diff: participate 是動詞（參加），participant 是名詞（參加的人）。
confusable.usage: participate 後面接 in + 活動；participant 是人，可以數。

example.en: Please participate in the survey before the end of this week.
example.zh: 請在本週結束前參與這項調查。

confusable.diff: partner 指合作夥伴，participant 指活動的參加者。

example.en: Our business partner will visit the office next Tuesday.
example.zh: 我們的商業夥伴下星期二會來辦公室拜訪。

similar.diff: attendee 指到場的人；participant 強調有參與活動。

example.en: Every attendee received a name tag at the registration desk.
example.zh: 每位出席者都在報名櫃台領到名牌。

example.en: The attendees were asked to fill in a short form.
example.zh: 出席者被要求填寫一份簡短的表格。

example.en: Each applicant must send a résumé before the deadline.
example.zh: 每位應徵者都必須在截止前寄出履歷。

example.en: Every team member should read the new safety rules.
example.zh: 每位團隊成員都應閱讀新的安全規定。

derived.link: participant 的 -ant 改成 -ate，變成動詞，像 operate

example.en: Over fifty employees participated in the charity run last month.
example.zh: 上個月有五十多位員工參加了慈善路跑。

example.en: Your participation in the survey will help us improve our service.
example.zh: 您參與調查將有助於我們改善服務。

extra_vocab.en: to write your name when you arrive, or to enter your account on a computer
extra_vocab.note: 在所在句裡指到前台寫下名字、辦理簽到，也是大型會議與公司訪客的常見要求。同一片語也能指登入電腦系統。
extra_vocab.pattern: sign in + at + 地點 / sign in to + 系統
extra_vocab.grammar_note: sign in 是不接受詞的片語動詞，說「簽到」直接用 sign in；登入系統要加 to，如 sign in to the system。

examples.en: All visitors must sign in at the security desk when they arrive.
examples.zh: 所有訪客抵達時都必須在警衛處簽到。

examples.en: Please sign in to the system with your employee number.
examples.zh: 請用你的員工編號登入系統。

examples.en: Guests can sign in at the registration table after nine o’clock.
examples.zh: 賓客九點後可以在報名桌簽到。

similar.diff: check in 常用在飯店與機場辦理手續；sign in 重點在寫下名字或登入。

example.en: Guests can check in at the hotel desk after two o’clock.
example.zh: 房客兩點後可以在飯店櫃台辦理入住。

similar.diff: log in 專指登入電腦或網站，語氣更偏電腦用語。

example.en: You need to log in to see the latest schedule.
example.zh: 你必須登入才能看到最新的行程表。

confusable.diff: sign up 是「報名、註冊」；sign in 是「簽到、登入」。

example.en: Employees can sign up for the training course on the intranet.
example.zh: 員工可以在內部網站報名這門訓練課程。

confusable.diff: sign out 是「簽退、登出」，和 sign in 意思相反。

example.en: Please sign out at the front desk when you leave the building.
example.zh: 離開大樓時請在櫃台簽退。

extra_vocab.en: the act of putting your name on an official list
extra_vocab.note: 在會議與活動通知中，registration 指報名手續，也常指現場的報到櫃台。參加者通常需先完成報名才能入場。

example.en: We have received over three hundred registrations for the seminar.
example.zh: 我們已收到三百多份研討會的報名。

example.en: Please complete the registration form and send it back by Friday.
example.zh: 請填妥報名表並在星期五前寄回。

example.en: The registration fee includes lunch and all training materials.
example.zh: 報名費包含午餐與所有訓練教材。

example.en: Online registration for the conference opens next Monday morning.
example.zh: 研討會的線上報名下星期一早上開放。

examples.en: Registration begins at eight, and the first session starts at nine.
examples.zh: 報到八點開始，第一場課程九點開始。

examples.en: Please bring your car registration when you visit the service center.
examples.zh: 到服務中心時請攜帶你的車輛登記證。

examples.en: The deadline for registration has been extended until the end of May.
examples.zh: 報名截止日已延長到五月底。

confusable.diff: reservation 是預訂座位或房間；registration 是報名或登記名字。

example.en: We made a reservation for twelve people at the restaurant.
example.zh: 我們在餐廳預訂了十二人的座位。

confusable.diff: resignation 是辭職，拼法和 registration 有點像，意思完全不同。

example.en: The manager handed in his resignation letter on Monday morning.
example.zh: 經理在星期一早上提出辭呈。

similar.diff: enrollment 多用於學校與課程的註冊；registration 用途更廣。

example.en: Enrollment in the language course closes at the end of June.
example.zh: 語言課程的註冊在六月底截止。

example.en: Please submit your application form by the end of this week.
example.zh: 請在本週結束前提交申請表。

example.en: Her gym membership will expire at the end of next month.
example.zh: 她的健身房會員資格下個月底到期。

example.en: Please register for the seminar on our website before Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前到我們網站報名研討會。

senses.en: the act of putting your name on a list for an event or class

example.en: Early registration for the workshop saves participants twenty dollars.
example.zh: 提早報名工作坊可為參加者省下二十美元。

senses.en: an official record that lists a person, a car, or a company
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 car、vehicle、company 等，指向政府或機關登記。

example.en: The company completed its business registration last week.
example.zh: 公司上週完成了商業登記。
